notes: Synthetic, from platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/streaming ("Error events": an overloaded_error event mid-stream; its data line is the page's) on the stream_native_text request; ids and text invented. The passthrough relays the error event unchanged; billing sees message_start's usage and no message_delta, so the handler estimates the output (applyAnthropicStreamUsage). Not recordable: nothing a client sends induces it.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap U8: the native passthrough bills input_tokens only; Anthropic's input_tokens excludes cache reads and writes, so the cached input of a failed stream is under-billed too
